Evolving Agent Teams演化型智能体团队：让智能体组织随优化进程共同演化

Shiyi Cao, Ziming Mao, Dacheng Li, Joseph E. Gonzalez, Ion Stoica  —  Sky Computing Lab, UC Berkeley
arXiv Abstract ↗ PDF ↗ HTML ↗ Code ↗ Edited translation · 全文对照
Abstract · English

The rapid progress of software engineering agents drives interest in applying them to open-ended problems such as GPU kernel optimization. However, we find that existing coding agents converge to local optima on real-world, expert-written kernels (e.g., FlashInfer). We introduce Evolving Agent Teams, a multi-agent framework that escapes such local optima. It features (1) a central supervisor that diagnoses each local optimum and restructures a team of agents; and (2) a persistent file system that comprises a learning document, an evolution history, and per-team artifacts, grounding restructuring with accumulated experience. Under a matched token budget, Evolving Agent Teams consistently outperforms strong coding-agent baselines. With an extended token budget, it generates a CUDA kernel that reaches 1.2× mean speedup over the production FlashInfer MLA paged decode kernel from scratch and wins on 36 of 47 production workloads from FlashInfer-Bench (0.86–0.99× on the remaining 11).

It also demonstrates superior performance on tasks such as KDA prefill on AMD MI350X (3.01× over vLLM) and NVIDIA B200 (3.44× over FlashKDA), MoE expert-offload serving on Apple silicon (30.3 tokens/s decode for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next in MLX 4-bit on a 48 GB M4 Pro), and RoboDojo robot manipulation (62.1 on held-out seeds vs. 55.3 for the best leaderboard entry). 译者一句话概括 / In one sentence 这篇论文的核心命题不是「让单个智能体更强」，而是把「智能体团队的组织结构」本身作为优化对象——当搜索在某个局部最优停滞时，由一个监督者诊断停滞的结构性原因（知识缺口、搜索枯竭、调试卡死、过度微优化），再改写角色分工、协作协议与知识管理方式，从而让团队在长时间任务的不同阶段都保持适配。
01

Introduction引言

The rapid progress of coding agents on software engineering tasks has driven interest in applying them to open-ended discovery tasks such as GPU kernel optimization. Here, the goal is not just to produce a correct kernel but to search a large, hardware-dependent design space for high performance. Expert-written kernels such as FlashInfer and FlashAttention navigate this space across two levels: low-level primitive use (e.g., WGMMA tensor cores, swizzled shared-memory layouts) and high-level architectural design (e.g., dispatch strategies, warp specialization, dataflow). While low-level primitive use can substantially improve performance within a chosen design, high-level architectural choices often determine which hardware bottlenecks remain and thus largely shape the attainable performance ceiling.

编程智能体在软件工程任务上的快速进步，促使人们尝试把它们用于 GPU 算子优化这类开放式「发现型」任务。此时目标不只是产出一个正确的算子，而是在一个庞大且依赖硬件的设计空间中搜索高性能实现。FlashInfer、FlashAttention 等由专家编写的算子会在两个层面上探索这一空间：底层原语的使用（例如 WGMMA 张量核心、带 swizzle 的共享内存布局）与高层架构设计（例如调度策略、warp specialization、数据流）。底层原语的使用可以在既定设计内显著提升性能，但高层架构选择往往决定了还残留哪些硬件瓶颈，因而在很大程度上塑造了可达的性能上限。

Unfortunately, even strong coding agents struggle to write challenging GPU kernels. They often make rapid initial progress, but then converge to local optima far below expert-written baselines. A common failure mode is that agents select design directions that are initially easier to implement but architecturally limited, spend most of their budget tuning within those directions, and fail to revisit harder alternatives that require substantial debugging or architectural rethinking.

不幸的是，即便是强大的编程智能体，也难以写出有挑战性的 GPU 算子。它们通常初期进展很快，随后便收敛到远低于专家基线的局部最优。一个常见失败模式是：智能体选择了初期更容易实现、但架构上受限的设计方向，把大部分预算花在该方向内的调参上，并且不再回头尝试那些需要大量调试或架构级重构的更难方案。

For example, when writing the MLA decode kernel used in DeepSeek-V3 inference, single-agent runs often abandoned difficult WGMMA-based implementations after repeated correctness failures, and instead optimized simpler but less efficient WMMA-based designs. These designs plateaued far below expert-written baselines: Codex 5.5 xHigh reaches only 28% of expert performance despite a $1K budget and multiple days of effort. Static agent teams show the same limitation (Section 4): a fixed 4-role team built with Claude Code Opus 4.7 1M reaches only 55%. These results suggest that neither stronger single agents nor fixed teams are sufficient for challenging GPU kernel optimization. The process moves through distinct phases, from establishing correctness to debugging hardware primitives, profiling bottlenecks, and redesigning the kernel architecture. Each phase requires different expertise, tools, and coordination patterns, causing fixed agent organizations to become mismatched to the current stage.

例如，在编写 DeepSeek-V3 推理所用的 MLA decode 算子时，单智能体运行常常在反复出现正确性失败后放弃困难的 WGMMA 实现，转而优化更简单但效率更低的 WMMA 设计。这类设计很快就在远低于专家基线的位置停滞：Codex 5.5 xHigh 即便拥有 1,000 美元预算并投入数天，也只达到专家性能的 28%。静态智能体团队表现出同样的局限（见第 4 节）：一个用 Claude Code Opus 4.7 1M 搭建的固定四角色团队仅达到 55%。这些结果表明，更强的单智能体与固定的团队都不足以胜任有挑战的 GPU 算子优化。该过程会经历若干截然不同的阶段：先建立正确性，再调试硬件原语、剖析瓶颈，最后重新设计算子架构。每个阶段需要不同的专长、工具与协作模式，于是固定的智能体组织会与当前阶段变得不再匹配。

We introduce Evolving Agent Teams, a multi-agent framework that escapes such local optima by evolving the agent team's organization alongside the optimization process. This evolution is driven by a central supervisor agent, grounded in a persistent file system with accumulated experience. Concretely, the supervisor monitors team progress, reflects on the agent behavior, diagnoses the cause of plateau (e.g., a knowledge gap or an exhausted search), and adapts the team accordingly: spawning specialists for high-effort tasks, introducing profiling roles to get more insights, or running parallel roles for different directions (Section 3.2). The file system contains a learning document of empirical observations, per-team artifacts, and an evolution history.

作者提出 Evolving Agent Teams：一种多智能体框架，通过让智能体团队的组织与优化进程同步演化，从而摆脱上述局部最优。这种演化由一位中央监督者智能体驱动，并以一个承载累积经验的持久化文件系统为基础。具体而言，监督者监控团队进展，反思智能体行为，诊断停滞的原因（例如知识缺口，或搜索空间已被穷尽），并据此调整团队：为高投入任务派生专才、引入剖析角色以获得更多洞见、或让不同方向并行推进（见 3.2 节）。文件系统中包含一份记录经验观察的学习文档、各团队的产物，以及一份演化历史。

On the MLA decode kernel, Evolving Agent Teams explores over 100 team configurations. The supervisor repeatedly reconfigures the team around the current failure mode, which improves token efficiency and enables successive architectural advances, including performant WGMMA-based matrix multiplication, a PV accumulation strategy, and L2 prefetching. Together, these improvements allow Evolving Agent Teams to substantially outperform prior single-agent and static-team approaches (Figure 1).

在 MLA decode 算子上，Evolving Agent Teams 探索了 100 多种团队配置。监督者围绕当前的失败模式反复重组团队，这既提升了 token 效率，也促成了接连的架构级进步——包括高性能的 WGMMA 矩阵乘、一种 PV 累加策略，以及 L2 预取。这些改进合在一起，使 Evolving Agent Teams 大幅优于此前的单智能体与静态团队方法（见图 1）。

We evaluate on four challenging CUDA kernel optimization tasks spanning two GPU architectures (Section 4): Flash Attention 4 and Gated Delta Net prefill on Blackwell B200, and MLA paged decode and fused GEMM+AllReduce (G+AR) on Hopper H100. Evolving Agent Teams outperforms strong coding agent baselines on every task. Notably, on the MLA paged decode task, evaluated on 47 production DeepSeek-V3 workloads from FlashInfer-Bench, Claude Code agent plateaus at 0.51× the expert-written FlashInfer kernel, while our system reaches 0.74× under a matched token budget. With additional budget, the system surpasses the production FlashInfer baseline, achieving 1.21× mean speedup, faster on 36 of 47 workloads, while the previous best result is 0.61× from K-Search.

作者在跨两代 GPU 架构的四个高难度 CUDA 算子优化任务上进行评估（第 4 节）：Blackwell B200 上的 Flash Attention 4 与 Gated Delta Net prefill，以及 Hopper H100 上的 MLA paged decode 与融合的 GEMM+AllReduce（G+AR）。Evolving Agent Teams 在每一个任务上都优于强编程智能体基线。特别地，在 MLA paged decode 任务上（使用 FlashInfer-Bench 的 47 个 DeepSeek-V3 生产负载评估），Claude Code 智能体停滞在专家版 FlashInfer 算子的 0.51×，而本系统在相同 token 预算下达到 0.74×。若给予额外预算，系统可超越生产版 FlashInfer 基线，平均加速达 1.21×，在 47 个负载中 36 个更快；而此前的最佳结果来自 K-Search，仅为 0.61×。

02

Related Work相关工作

Multi-agent LLM systems. ChatDev, MetaGPT, and MAGIS assign fixed roles (programmer, reviewer, tester) to distinct agents for software engineering. AutoGen provides a general multi-agent conversation framework; DyLAN and AgentVerse dynamically adapt the team's role composition during execution, but either select from a hand-crafted pool of role prompts (DyLAN) or regenerate the group from scratch each round without preserving global context across re-compositions (AgentVerse). Our framework differs in two respects: (1) it operates over multi-day horizons where the nature of productive work changes qualitatively (from knowledge acquisition to search to verification), requiring changes to agent roles and mandates, not merely routing; and (2) the supervisor maintains a persistent global file system across team restructurings.

多智能体 LLM 系统。ChatDev、MetaGPT 与 MAGIS 为软件工程中的不同智能体分配固定角色（程序员、评审者、测试者）。AutoGen 提供通用的多智能体对话框架；DyLAN 与 AgentVerse 能在执行过程中动态调整团队的角色构成，但前者是从人工设计的角色提示池中挑选，后者在每一轮都从零重建团队，且不在多次重组之间保留全局上下文。本框架有两点不同：(1) 它面向长达数天的时间尺度，其间「有效工作的性质」会发生质变（从知识获取到搜索、再到验证），因此需要改变智能体的角色与授权范围，而不仅仅是路由；(2) 监督者在多次团队重组之间维护一个持久的全局文件系统。

Self-improving agents and evolutionary search. Reflexion accumulates verbal feedback across trials; Voyager builds a growing skill library. These approaches improve a single agent's behavior within a fixed role, whereas our framework adapts the broader optimization process around a single agent. FunSearch, OpenEvolve and AlphaEvolve use population-based evolutionary search with LLM-driven mutation over programs. Our approach differs in that it employs no population and no crossover; instead, a supervisor performs sequential, diagnosis-driven adaptation of the agent team architecture. ADAS uses an LLM with an archive to iteratively propose new agent architectures. Our work also uses an LLM to iteratively adapt the team architecture. However, the purpose of this adaptation is different: rather than searching for a standalone best agent architecture, we evolve the team to better facilitate the optimization process at different stages.

自我改进智能体与演化式搜索。Reflexion 在多次尝试中累积自然语言反馈；Voyager 构建不断增长的技能库。这些方法是在固定角色内改进单个智能体的行为，而本框架则是在单个智能体之外，改进更大的优化流程。FunSearch、OpenEvolve 与 AlphaEvolve 采用基于种群的演化搜索，由 LLM 对程序进行变异。本方法的不同之处在于不使用种群、也不做交叉：而是由监督者执行顺序的、以诊断驱动的团队架构调整。ADAS 用一个 LLM 配合存档来迭代提出新的智能体架构；本文同样用 LLM 迭代调整团队架构，但目的不同——不是为了搜索出某个孤立的最优架构，而是让团队在优化的不同阶段更好地支撑该优化过程。

Meta-optimization and text optimization. A growing body of work uses LLMs to optimize text and code artifacts iteratively. OPRO optimizes prompts conditioned on past (solution, score) pairs; TextGrad provides textual feedback on current artifacts; GEPA uses reflective feedback from rollout traces. Meta-Harness optimizes the code surrounding a fixed LLM by giving a coding-agent proposer full filesystem access to prior candidates' source code, scores, and execution traces. Our work shares the insight that richer access to prior experience enables better meta-optimization. However, the object of optimization is different: Meta-Harness optimizes the surrounding harness, whereas our method adapts the search process itself to better discover high-performance kernel implementations.

元优化与文本优化。越来越多的工作用 LLM 迭代优化文本与代码产物：OPRO 依据历史的（解，得分）对来优化提示词；TextGrad 对当前产物给出文本反馈；GEPA 利用来自 rollout 轨迹的反思性反馈。Meta-Harness 让一个编程智能体提议者完整访问既往候选的源码、得分与执行轨迹，从而优化固定在某个 LLM 之外的外围代码。本文认同「更充分地接触既往经验能带来更好的元优化」这一洞见，但优化的对象不同：Meta-Harness 优化的是外围的 harness，而本方法调整的是搜索过程本身，以便更好地发现高性能算子实现。

Code generation and optimization, and inference-time scaling. SWE-agent, SkyRL-Agent and SWE-Gym advance agents in software engineering tasks. In GPU kernel optimization, most of the existing LLM-based solutions adopt a fixed human-designed system, where LLMs refine kernels based on compilation or profiling feedback. Some recent works add evolutionary strategies into the system for maintaining and selecting candidates. K-Search decouples planning from implementation via a co-evolving world model but employs a fixed two-role configuration. Inference-time compute scaling improves reasoning within a fixed inference-time search procedure; our framework addresses the complementary problem of adapting the search process itself.

代码生成与优化，以及推理时扩展。SWE-agent、SkyRL-Agent 与 SWE-Gym 推进了软件工程任务中的智能体。在 GPU 算子优化方面，多数现有 LLM 方案采用固定的人工设计系统，由 LLM 依据编译或剖析反馈精炼算子；一些近期工作把演化策略引入系统，用于维护与选择候选。K-Search 通过一个协同演化的世界模型把规划与实现解耦，但采用的是固定的双角色配置。推理时计算扩展是在固定的推理搜索流程内部改进推理；本框架处理的则是与之互补的问题——调整搜索流程本身。

Method方法

Figure 2. The Evolving Agent Teams framework. Team execution runs coding agents on the task through tool use and execution feedback. Team evolution acts as a meta-optimizer: it analyzes the past success and failure patterns, and adapts the team composition, role specialization, coordination protocol, and knowledge management for the current stage of discovery.

图 2. Evolving Agent Teams 框架。团队执行层通过工具调用与执行反馈，让编程智能体在任务上工作；团队演化层则充当元优化器：分析既往的成功与失败模式，并针对当前的发现阶段调整团队构成、角色专业化、协作协议与知识管理方式。

3.1 Problem Setup问题设定

We consider open-ended program optimization tasks: given a goal description, a codebase, and correctness constraints C, find a solution s ∈ P (an executable program) that maximizes a scoring function F : P → R while satisfying C. Performance is measured against a finite token budget.

Existing LLM-based systems tackling this problem can be characterized by an agent team configuration T = (R, Π, M) governing three design choices:

  • Roles R — what each agent is responsible for, e.g., a single generalist, fixed programmer/reviewer/tester, or an LLM mutation operator.
  • Coordination Π — how agents interact, e.g., no coordination (single agent), a fixed role-to-role pipeline, or a select-mutate-evaluate cycle.
  • Knowledge management M — how experience is accumulated and shared, e.g., the filesystem with no explicit management, structured message passing enforced by fixed protocol, or a candidate archive.

In most existing frameworks, all three are human-designed and fixed before the run begins.1 These systems optimize the solution s but do not adapt T itself, making them prone to stagnation at local optima during long-running open-ended optimization tasks.

本文考虑的开放式程序优化任务为：给定目标描述、代码库与正确性约束 C，寻找一个解 s ∈ P（一个可执行程序），在满足 C 的同时最大化评分函数 F : P → ℝ。性能以有限的 token 预算来衡量。

现有用于该问题的 LLM 系统可以用一个智能体团队配置 T = (R, Π, M) 来刻画，它由三项设计选择决定：

  • 角色 R——每个智能体负责什么，例如单一通才、固定的程序员/评审者/测试者，或一个 LLM 变异算子。
  • 协作 Π——智能体如何交互，例如无协作（单智能体）、固定的角色间流水线，或「选择–变异–评估」循环。
  • 知识管理 M——经验如何累积与共享，例如不加显式管理的文件系统、由固定协议强制的结构化消息传递，或一个候选存档。

在多数现有框架中，这三者都由人工设计，并在运行开始前固定。1 这些系统只优化解 s，却不调整 T 本身，因此在长时间开放式优化任务中容易停滞于局部最优。

原文脚注 1 一些演化式系统会在运行中调整搜索超参数（例如 AdaEvolve 调节探索强度与预算分配）；本文所说的「固定」特指团队配置 T = (R, Π, M)，即角色、协作协议与知识管理策略——在上述所有系统中它们都保持静态。

3.2 Evolving Agent Teams演化型智能体团队

Evolving Agent Teams co-evolves T alongside s, adapting the optimization system to better facilitate the discovery. It operates at two levels, following the loop shown in Figure 2: at the team evolution level, a supervisor agent monitors each team's execution, analyzes success and failure patterns, and designs the next team Tv+1. At the team execution level, a team of LLM-based coding agents works on the task under the current configuration Tv. A persistent file system K connects the two levels, accumulating all records across team executions and restructurings: a learnings document of accumulated empirical observations, per-team artifacts (kernels and per-role records), and the evolution history (the supervisor's reflections and design decisions from each version), so that each team can build on and improve upon prior work.

Evolving Agent Teams 让 T 与 s 共同演化，使优化系统本身变得更能促成发现。它按图 2 的循环在两个层面运作：在团队演化层，一位监督者智能体监控每个团队的执行，分析成功与失败模式，并设计下一个团队 Tv+1；在团队执行层，一组基于 LLM 的编程智能体在当前配置 Tv 下执行任务。一个持久化文件系统 K 连接这两个层面，累积跨越各次团队执行与重组的全部记录：记录经验观察的学习文档、各团队产物（算子与每个角色的记录）、以及演化历史（监督者在每个版本中的反思与设计决策），使每个团队都能在前人工作的基础上继续改进。

Team Evolution · 团队演化

The supervisor is triggered by two signals: the current team finishing its run, or a fixed-interval cron job. Upon either, it checks the team's progress so far, reflects on any observed failure or success patterns (e.g., drifting to easy paths, key insights from previous teams lost, stuck in debugging, and heavily micro-optimizing), and designs the next team along the three axes of T:

  • Roles. The supervisor invents roles as needed, rather than selecting from a predefined set. A single agent handling implementation, profiling, and research simultaneously divides its limited context across all three, sacrificing depth in each. The supervisor addresses this by creating focused roles such as Profiling Scientist (designs targeted microbenchmarks to isolate bottlenecks), Challenger (stress-tests claimed performance ceilings), Primitive Study Agent (studies potentially useful primitives and their usage, running small tests), and Knowledge Integrator (synthesizes findings scattered across prior teams into actionable plans).
  • Coordination. The supervisor decides how agents interact: it can pipeline them (research → implement → profile), run them in parallel on separate branches, or combine both. For example, the supervisor may spawn one agent solely to debug a blocking issue (forbidden from touching the main codebase) while a second agent continues optimizations on the main branch, so that one agent's failure does not block the other's progress.
  • Knowledge management. The supervisor evolves how teams manage their experience and learning within K, specifying where each agent should output: e.g., write findings into a dedicated document, append learnings during execution to a team-shared log, or commit code to a specific branch. When early insights were getting lost across teams, the supervisor introduced a cross-agent synthesis document that connected all prior findings into an actionable plan, and mandated future teams to read it.

监督者由两类信号触发：当前团队跑完，或一个固定间隔的定时任务。任一触发后，它会检查团队目前的进展，反思观察到的失败或成功模式（例如滑向容易的路径、丢失了前序团队的关键洞见、卡在调试中、以及过度陷入微观优化），并沿 T 的三个轴设计下一个团队：

  • 角色。监督者按需「发明」角色，而不是从预先定义的集合中挑选。一个智能体若同时承担实现、剖析与研究，就会把有限的上下文分摊到三件事上，牺牲每一件的深度。监督者的对策是创建专注的角色，例如剖析科学家（设计有针对性的微基准以隔离瓶颈）、挑战者（对声称的性能上限做压力测试）、原语研究智能体（研究可能有用的原语及其用法，并跑小规模测试）、知识整合者（把分散在历届团队中的发现综合为可执行的计划）。附录表 3 列出了观察到的其他角色。
  • 协作。监督者决定智能体如何交互：可以把它们串成流水线（研究 → 实现 → 剖析），也可以让它们在各自分支上并行，或两者结合。例如，监督者可以专门派生一个智能体去调试阻塞性问题（禁止其改动主代码库），同时让另一个智能体在主分支上继续优化，从而避免一个智能体的失败阻塞另一个的进展。
  • 知识管理。监督者会演化团队在 K 中管理经验与学习的方式，规定每个智能体的产出应写到哪里：例如把发现写入专门文档、在执行过程中把学习记录追加到团队共享日志、或把代码提交到指定分支。当早期洞见在团队间不断丢失时，监督者引入了一份跨智能体的综合文档，把此前所有发现串成可执行的计划，并强制后续团队阅读它。

Team Execution · 团队执行

Each team execution deploys the agents specified by Tv on the task. Each agent is an LLM-based coding agent with shell access, able to read and write files, execute commands, run compilers and profilers, and iterate autonomously on the codebase. Agents receive their role mandates and access to the codebase, evaluation tools, and the file system K. One agent's outputs (committed code, profiling reports, written analyses) become inputs for others according to the coordination plan.

每次团队执行都把 Tv 指定的智能体部署到任务上。每个智能体都是具备 shell 权限的 LLM 编程智能体，能够读写文件、执行命令、运行编译器与剖析器，并在代码库上自主迭代。智能体接收角色指令，并获得对代码库、评测工具与文件系统 K 的访问权。按协作计划，一个智能体的产出（提交的代码、剖析报告、书面分析）会成为其他智能体的输入。

File System · 文件系统

The file system K is a shared filesystem that persists and grows across all team versions. K contains the codebase, evaluation tools, and all records produced by prior teams: the learnings document, per-team artifacts (kernels and per-role records), and the evolution history. This continuity is critical for long-running optimization: each team inherits all prior learnings, failed attempts, and successful strategies, enabling continuous experience accumulation that may open up new optimization directions.

文件系统 K 是一个跨所有团队版本持续存在并不断增长的共享文件系统。K 包含代码库、评测工具，以及既往团队产生的全部记录：学习文档、各团队产物（算子与每个角色的记录）与演化历史。这种连续性对长时间优化至关重要：每个团队都继承此前所有的学习成果、失败尝试与成功策略，从而实现经验的持续累积，并可能由此开辟新的优化方向。

03.3

MLA Decode: A Case Study案例研究：MLA Decode 算子中的团队演化

In this section, we present a detailed case study of the MLA decode kernel optimization with Evolving Agent Teams. Figure 1 shows the performance trajectory of the evolving team. The boxes below show representative evolution steps, each summarizing the observed agent behavior, the supervisor's reflection, the team design change, and the outcome.

本节以 MLA decode 算子优化为例，详细剖析 Evolving Agent Teams 的工作方式。图 1 展示了演化团队的性能轨迹；下面的方框给出若干代表性的演化步骤，每一步都归纳了：观察到的智能体行为、监督者的反思、团队设计上的改动，以及结果。

V1 → V2 Enforcing discipline · 施加纪律 0.15× → 0.065×（首个正确的 WGMMA 算子）
BehaviorSolo agent drifted from WGMMA to scalar code under pressure; no profiling was done; multi-variable changes made attribution impossible.
ReflectionThe agent needs external discipline. Without enforcement, it abandons hard constraints when they become inconvenient.
DesignRoles: +Disciplinarian (blocks non-WGMMA commits, enforces one-change-per-commit). Coordination: Disciplinarian checks after every commit. Knowledge: introduced LEARNINGS.md for persistent cross-run discoveries.
OutcomeFirst validated correct WGMMA kernel. Discipline held (one rule-gaming attempt blocked by supervisor).
行为单智能体在压力下从 WGMMA 滑向标量代码；没有做任何剖析；多变量同时改动使效果无法归因。
反思该智能体需要外部纪律。若无强制约束，它会在困难时放弃硬性约束。
设计角色：新增纪律官（阻止非 WGMMA 提交，强制「一次提交只改一处」）。协作：纪律官在每次提交后检查。知识：引入 LEARNINGS.md，持久记录跨运行发现。
结果得到首个通过验证的正确 WGMMA 算子；纪律得以维持（一次试图钻规则空子的行为被监督者拦截）。
V5 → V6 Supervisor-orchestrated parallelism · 监督者编排并行 0.34× → 0.49×（+44%）
BehaviorV3–V5 each independently attempted P@V WGMMA integration and failed on the same root cause. Structural changes require isolation debugging then integration — one agent session is too short for both.
ReflectionOffering pair-spawning to the agent doesn't work (V5 never used it). The supervisor should orchestrate parallelism directly.
DesignRoles: Focused Debugger (P@V WGMMA only, forbidden from main kernel) + Main Optimizer (micro-ops only, forbidden from P@V). Coordination: fully parallel, isolated branches.
OutcomeDebugger failed P@V conclusively (dead end confirmed). Optimizer made 12 commits for +44%, unblocked by the parallel pattern.
行为V3–V5 各自独立尝试 P@V 的 WGMMA 集成，都在同一个根因上失败。结构性改动需要先隔离调试、再集成，而一个智能体会话的长度不足以同时完成两者。
反思把「成对派生」的权限交给智能体并不奏效（V5 从未使用）。监督者应当直接编排并行。
设计角色：专注调试者（只做 P@V 的 WGMMA，禁止碰主算子）+ 主优化者（只做微观优化，禁止碰 P@V）。协作：完全并行、分支隔离。
结果调试者确凿地判定 P@V 路线不可行（确认是死胡同）；优化者做了 12 次提交、取得 +44%，其进展被并行模式解锁。
V7 → V8 Cross-team knowledge synthesis · 跨团队知识综合 0.50× → 0.51×（知识突破）
BehaviorV4 had recommended "use WGMMA RS with P in registers" but V5–V7 all ignored this because the recommendation was in V4's report, not in the shared learnings.
ReflectionLost knowledge between teams is the biggest structural weakness. Per-experiment facts are captured but cross-experiment strategic recommendations are not.
DesignRoles: +Knowledge Integrator. Knowledge: introduced SYNTHESIS.md connecting all agents' findings into an actionable plan. Mandated all future teams to read it.
OutcomeRS standalone test passed (first P@V WGMMA success ever). Directly enabled V9's integration milestone.
行为V4 曾建议「使用 WGMMA RS，并把 P 放在寄存器中」，但 V5–V7 全部忽略了它——因为该建议写在 V4 的报告里，而不在共享学习文档中。
反思团队之间的知识丢失是最大的结构性弱点。单次实验的事实被记录下来了，但跨实验的战略性建议没有。
设计角色：新增知识整合者。知识：引入 SYNTHESIS.md，把所有智能体的发现串成可执行计划，并强制后续所有团队阅读。
结果RS 独立测试通过（P@V 的 WGMMA 首次成功），直接促成了 V9 的集成里程碑。
V9 → V10 Re-profiling after a structural change · 结构变更后重新剖析 0.50× → 0.66×（+32%）
BehaviorV9 integrated P@V WGMMA RS, changing the kernel's bottleneck structure completely.
ReflectionWith both GEMMs on WGMMA, the kernel needs fresh profiling — all prior bottleneck analysis is stale.
DesignRoles: standard Profile-Driven Optimizer on the new architecture. Coordination: solo, profile-first discipline. Knowledge: inherited full K including V9's integration learnings.
Outcome9 commits, +32%. Split-K retune alone gave +4.1. Structural change unlocked entirely new optimization surface.
行为V9 集成了 P@V 的 WGMMA RS，彻底改变了算子的瓶颈结构。
反思两个 GEMM 都改到 WGMMA 后，算子需要重新剖析——此前所有瓶颈分析都已过时。
设计角色：面向新架构的标准剖析驱动优化者。协作：单人、剖析优先的纪律。知识：继承完整 K，包括 V9 的集成经验。
结果9 次提交，+32%。仅重调 Split-K 一项就带来 +4.1。结构性变更解锁了全新的优化空间。

This trajectory illustrates the strength of Evolving Agent Teams in responding to failures that no fixed design can foresee: the supervisor observes a concrete dysfunction, diagnoses its structural cause, and restructures roles, coordination, or knowledge management to address it. Section 4 evaluates how these adaptations translate into quantitative gains across multiple tasks.

这一轨迹体现了 Evolving Agent Teams 的强项：应对任何固定设计都无法预见的失败。监督者观察到具体的功能失调，诊断其结构性成因，再通过重构角色、协作或知识管理来解决它。第 4 节评估这些调整如何在多个任务上转化为量化收益。

Task / 任务GPULanguage / 语言Workloads / 负载Baseline / 基线Seed / 起点
FA4B200CuTe DSL24FlashAttention-40.17× 的 CuTe DSL 算子

4.1 Experimental Setup实验设置

Tasks. We evaluate on four GPU kernel optimization tasks spanning two architectures (Table 1). FA4 targets the attention forward pass, written in CuTe DSL; the challenge is co-designing algorithm and kernel pipelining for Blackwell's asymmetric hardware scaling, where tensor core throughput doubles but shared memory bandwidth and non-matmul units do not. GDN computes a prefill pass for Gated DeltaNet, a linear RNN with a matrix-valued hidden state; the challenge is parallelizing the inherently sequential recurrence over long sequences via a chunkwise algorithm. MLA implements paged decode for DeepSeek-V3's Multi-head Latent Attention; the challenge is overlapping CUDA core and tensor core work efficiently under extreme register pressure due to MLA's large head dimension. G+AR fuses GEMM with inter-GPU AllReduce into a single kernel, overlapping computation and communication; efficient fusing requires writing a custom WGMMA GEMM kernel with tile-level scheduling to overlap reduction with compute.

任务。评测涵盖跨两代架构的四个 GPU 算子优化任务（表 1）。FA4 针对注意力前向计算，用 CuTe DSL 编写；难点在于为 Blackwell 的非对称硬件扩展（张量核心吞吐翻倍，而共享内存带宽与非矩阵单元并未翻倍）协同设计算法与内核流水线。GDN 计算 Gated DeltaNet 的 prefill——一种隐状态为矩阵的线性 RNN；难点是用分块（chunkwise）算法把本质串行的递推在长序列上并行化。MLA 实现 DeepSeek-V3 多头潜在注意力的 paged decode；难点是在 MLA 头维度很大所导致的极端寄存器压力下，高效重叠 CUDA core 与张量核心的工作。G+AR 把 GEMM 与跨 GPU 的 AllReduce 融合进单个算子，以重叠计算与通信；高效融合需要自定义 WGMMA GEMM 算子，并用 tile 级调度把归约与计算重叠起来。

Metrics. For each task, we report the speedup relative to the production baseline: the geometric mean of tbase/tkernel across a set of workloads, where tbase and tkernel are the baseline and optimized kernel latencies respectively. Values above 1.0× indicate the optimized kernel is faster than the baseline; values below 1.0× indicate it is slower. All settings are run twice; we report the best result from each pair. We acknowledge this limits statistical conclusions and discuss implications in Section 5.

Workloads. GDN prefill and MLA workloads are drawn from FlashInfer-Bench, which provides representative production serving shapes. FA4 workloads use the same shapes as used in the performance report in the FlashAttention-4 paper. G+AR workloads are taken from the ThunderKittens benchmark suite.

指标。每个任务报告相对生产基线的加速比：即在一组负载上 tbase/tkernel 的几何平均，其中 tbase 与 tkernel 分别为基线与优化后算子的延迟。大于 1.0× 表示优化算子更快，小于 1.0× 表示更慢。所有设置各跑两次，报告每对中的最好结果。作者明确承认这会限制统计结论的强度，并在第 5 节讨论其含义。

负载。GDN prefill 与 MLA 的负载取自 FlashInfer-Bench，后者提供了具有代表性的生产服务形状。FA4 使用与 FlashAttention-4 论文性能报告相同的形状。G+AR 的负载取自 ThunderKittens 基准套件。

Baselines. (1) Claude Code: powered by Claude Opus 4.6 with a 1M context window, a state-of-the-art coding agent with file editing, shell access, and compiler invocation that autonomously writes, compiles, profiles, and iterates on kernel code. It receives the same task description, reference kernel, and test harness as the evolving team; evaluated on all four tasks in the budget-controlled experiment. (2) Fixed four-role team: a static team of four common high-value roles for GPU kernel optimization (Profiler, Hardware Researcher, Planner, Implementer), each powered by Claude Code with the same Opus 4.7 1M model, but with no supervisor and no team restructuring; evaluated on MLA in the ablation study. (3) Codex: a strong coding agent powered by GPT-5.5 xhigh with 258K context; evaluated on MLA in the ablation study. (4) Kernel-specific systems: K-Search and CUDAForge, run from their publicly released implementations with Claude Opus 4.6; evaluated on MLA.

基线。(1) Claude Code：由 Claude Opus 4.6（1M 上下文）驱动，是当时最强的编程智能体之一，具备文件编辑、shell 与编译器调用能力，可自主编写、编译、剖析并迭代算子代码。它获得与演化团队相同的任务描述、参考算子与测试 harness，在预算受控实验中覆盖全部四个任务。(2) 固定四角色团队：由 GPU 算子优化中四个常见高价值角色（剖析者、硬件研究者、规划者、实现者）构成的静态团队，每个角色由同一 Opus 4.7 1M 模型的 Claude Code 驱动，但没有监督者、不做团队重组；在 MLA 的消融实验中评估。(3) Codex：由 GPT-5.5 xhigh（258K 上下文）驱动的强编程智能体；在 MLA 消融实验中评估。(4) 算子专用系统：K-Search 与 CUDAForge，使用其公开实现并以 Claude Opus 4.6 运行；在 MLA 上评估。

Implementation. Evolving Agent Teams is built on top of Claude Code agents powered by Claude Opus 4.6 with 1M context. The supervisor is itself a Claude Code agent that orchestrates team evolution by spawning and monitoring worker agents. There are no predefined initial roles or team configurations; the supervisor designs all roles, coordination plans, and knowledge management strategies from scratch based on the task description.

实现。Evolving Agent Teams 构建在由 Claude Opus 4.6（1M 上下文）驱动的 Claude Code 智能体之上。监督者本身也是一个 Claude Code 智能体，通过派生与监控工作智能体来编排团队演化。没有任何预定义初始角色或团队配置：所有角色、协作计划与知识管理策略，均由监督者依据任务描述从零设计。

4.2 Budget-Controlled Progress Curves预算受控的进展曲线

Figure 3. Performance comparison across four kernel tasks. (a) Solid lines show the best of two runs; dashed lines show the second run. Cost computed under published per-token pricing (Claude Opus 4.6 1M). (b) Each dot is one workload. "Evolving Teams (ext.)" denotes longer runs beyond the budget-controlled setting; Evolving Agent Teams shifts the distribution rightward on all tasks.

Figure 3(a) plots performance vs. cumulative weighted cost, while Figure 3(b) shows per-workload speedup distributions. Cost is computed from per-token API pricing: for Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context), $0.50 / $6.25 / $5.00 / $25.00 per million tokens for cache-read / cache-create / input / output respectively; for GPT-5.5 xhigh (Codex ablation), $0.50 / $5.00 / $30.00 per million tokens for cached-input / input / output.

图 3。四个算子任务的性能对比。(a) 实线为两次运行中较好的一次，虚线为第二次运行；成本按公开的每 token 价格计算（Claude Opus 4.6 1M）。(b) 每个点是一个负载；「Evolving Teams (ext.)」表示超出预算受控设置的长跑。Evolving Agent Teams 在所有任务上都使性能分布右移。

图 3(a) 绘出性能与累计加权成本的关系，图 3(b) 绘出各负载的加速比分布。成本按每 token API 价格折算：Claude Opus 4.6（1M 上下文）的缓存读/缓存写/输入/输出分别为每百万 token 0.50 / 6.25 / 5.00 / 25.00 美元；GPT-5.5 xhigh（Codex 消融）的缓存输入/输入/输出分别为 0.50 / 5.00 / 30.00 美元。

Evolving Agent Teams outperforms Claude Code: Claude Code curves flatten early on FA4 and GDN Prefill, while Evolving Agent Teams continues improving with more budget spent. On MLA decode, Claude Code plateaus around 0.44–0.51×: it abandons the difficult WGMMA tensor core implementation after repeated failures at correctness and instead uses the WMMA API, which limits the tensor core utilization compared to WGMMA. The evolving team reaches 0.75× under the budget-controlled setting (1.21× with additional budget, as shown in Figure 1).

Evolving Agent Teams 优于 Claude Code：Claude Code 的曲线在 FA4 与 GDN Prefill 上很早便趋平，而 Evolving Agent Teams 会随预算增加持续改进。在 MLA decode 上，Claude Code 在 0.44–0.51× 附近停滞：它在反复出现正确性失败后放弃了困难的 WGMMA 张量核心实现，转而使用 WMMA API，相对 WGMMA 限制了张量核心的利用率。演化团队在预算受控设置下达到 0.75×（若给予额外预算则达 1.21×，见图 1）。

The GDN prefill panel shows particularly high speedups (>2×) because the 100-workload benchmark includes many small input sizes where FlashInfer's planning and preprocessing overhead dominates end-to-end latency, even with plan() cached across calls. Our generated kernel requires no planning stage, so on these small workloads it achieves disproportionately large speedups. Under the budget-controlled setting, the best Evolving Agent Teams run has a worst workload of 0.19× with 43 of 100 below the baseline, compared to 0.13× and 49 of 100 for the best Claude Code run. With additional budget, the worst workload improves to 0.40× with 37 of 100 below the baseline.

GDN prefill 一栏的加速比特别高（>2×），原因是这个 100 个负载的基准中，许多小输入尺寸下 FlashInfer 的规划与预处理开销主导了端到端延迟——即使 plan() 在多次调用间被缓存。本文生成的算子不需要规划阶段，因此在这些小负载上获得了不成比例的大幅加速。在预算受控设置下，最好的 Evolving Agent Teams 运行最差负载为 0.19×，100 个中有 43 个低于基线；最好的 Claude Code 运行则为 0.13×、49 个低于基线。给足额外预算后，最差负载改善到 0.40×，低于基线的负载降至 37 个。

On GEMM+AllReduce, the single-agent run produces a cuBLAS-based kernel, yielding a mean speedup of 1.08× compared to the cuBLAS + NCCL baseline. The budget-controlled evolving team similarly converges on a cuBLAS+NCCL pipeline, achieving 1.18× with stronger gains at larger matrix sizes (32K: 1.34×). With additional budget, the team discovers a fused WGMMA+NVLS kernel that bypasses cuBLAS entirely and leverages NVLink multicast for the all-reduce, reaching 1.49× overall and 2.57× on the smallest workload where communication latency dominates.

在 GEMM+AllReduce 上，单智能体运行产出基于 cuBLAS 的算子，相对 cuBLAS + NCCL 基线平均加速 1.08×。预算受控的演化团队也收敛到一条 cuBLAS+NCCL 流水线，取得 1.18×，且在更大矩阵尺寸上收益更强（32K 时 1.34×）。给予额外预算后，团队发现了一个融合的 WGMMA+NVLS 算子，完全绕过 cuBLAS，并利用 NVLink 多播完成 all-reduce，整体达到 1.49×，在通信延迟主导的最小负载上达到 2.57×。

Across all four tasks, the best Evolving Agent Teams kernel matches or exceeds the best Claude Code kernel on nearly every workload (Figure 3(b)), with a single exception on MLA decode. This broad coverage suggests the system does not overfit to a narrow regime; we attribute it to the supervisor's tendency to evolve roles such as Workload Analyst that explicitly diagnose per-workload regressions and steer optimization toward balanced performance (Appendix A).

在四个任务上，最好的 Evolving Agent Teams 算子在几乎每一个负载上都达到或超过最好的 Claude Code 算子（图 3(b)），仅 MLA decode 上有一个例外。这种广泛的覆盖说明系统没有过拟合到某个狭窄区间；作者将其归因于监督者倾向于演化出负载分析者这类角色，显式诊断各负载的退步并把优化导向均衡性能（附录 A）。

4.3 Scaling with Additional Budget增加预算后的扩展

Figure 4. Evolution trajectories for GDN and G+AR with additional budget beyond the controlled comparison. Each point is one team version; the step line tracks the running best.

GDN Prefill continues to improve from a 2.2× kernel to 4.06× mean speedup across 21 team versions. With the additional budget, the worst-case workload improves 0.40×, and the number of workloads below the baseline drops from 43 to 37 of 100, indicating that extended optimization disproportionately benefits the hardest workloads where the initial kernel architecture was less suited.

G+AR reaches 1.56× over the cuBLAS+NCCL baseline, comparable to ThunderKittens, which is at 1.54× over cuBLAS+NCCL. The trajectory illustrates three distinct phases that require qualitatively different capabilities. Versions 1–5 focus on correctness: the team debugs WGMMA register layouts and IPC cache coherence for multi-GPU communication, producing a working but slow two-phase kernel (0.54×). Versions 6–10 introduce TMA asynchronous loads and a warp-specialized pipeline that first exceeds the baseline (1.08×). Versions 15–22 shift to a fundamentally different architecture: the team replaces cuBLAS with a custom WGMMA kernel fused with NVLink multicast for the all-reduce, culminating in cluster-level TMA multicast (1.56×).

图 4。在受控对比之外，给 GDN 与 G+AR 追加预算后的演化轨迹。每个点是一个团队版本，阶梯线跟踪历史最好成绩。

GDN Prefill 在 21 个团队版本中从 2.2× 持续提升到 4.06× 平均加速。追加预算后，最差负载改善至 0.40×，低于基线的负载从 100 个中的 43 个降到 37 个，说明延长的优化不成比例地惠及最难的负载——即初始算子架构本就不太适配的那部分。

G+AR 相对 cuBLAS+NCCL 基线达到 1.56×，与 ThunderKittens 的 1.54× 相当。其轨迹展示了需要截然不同能力的三个阶段：版本 1–5 聚焦正确性——团队调试 WGMMA 寄存器布局与多 GPU 通信中的 IPC 缓存一致性，产出可用但很慢的两阶段算子（0.54×）；版本 6–10 引入 TMA 异步加载与 warp 专用流水线，首次超过基线（1.08×）；版本 15–22 转向根本不同的架构——用自定义 WGMMA 算子替代 cuBLAS，并把 NVLink 多播融合进 all-reduce，最终以集群级 TMA 多播收官（1.56×）。

4.4 Optimizing an Already-Optimized Implementation优化「已被优化过」的实现

Figure 5. Flash-KMeans (H100). (a) Evolution trajectory; each point is one kernel version. (b) Per-iteration latency comparison across the paper's benchmark grid (D=128, FP16). Our CUDA WGMMA kernel achieves up to 1.5× lower latency on compute-bound configurations (high K), while matching Triton on memory-bound regimes.

The four tasks above start from naïve reference kernels. To test whether Evolving Agent Teams can also improve code that has already been carefully optimized by domain experts, we apply it to Flash-KMeans, a recent GPU-optimized exact K-Means implementation. Flash-KMeans fuses distance computation with online argmin (FlashAssign) to bypass HBM materialization of the N×K distance matrix and introduces a sort-inverse update that transforms high-contention atomic scatters into segment-level localized reductions, achieving up to 17.9× end-to-end speedup over prior GPU baselines on H200. The released implementation uses hand-tuned Triton kernels. We task the Evolving Agent Teams with rewriting the assignment kernel in CUDA, starting from the Triton source as a reference rather than a naïve PyTorch baseline. The system produces a CUDA WGMMA kernel that reaches 1.71× speedup over the Triton kernel on the default workload, and achieves up to 1.5× lower latency on compute-bound configurations (high K) across the full benchmark grid.

图 5。Flash-KMeans（H100）。(a) 演化轨迹，每个点是一个算子版本。(b) 在该文基准网格（D=128，FP16）上的逐迭代延迟对比。本文的 CUDA WGMMA 算子在计算受限配置（大 K）下延迟最多降低 1.5×，在访存受限区间则与 Triton 持平。

上述四个任务都从朴素参考算子出发。为了检验 Evolving Agent Teams 是否也能改进已由领域专家精心优化过的代码，作者把它应用于 Flash-KMeans——一个近期的 GPU 优化精确 K-Means 实现。Flash-KMeans 把距离计算与在线 argmin 融合（FlashAssign），以避免把 N×K 距离矩阵写入 HBM，并引入「排序–逆更新」把高竞争的原子散射转换为段级局部归约，在 H200 上相对此前 GPU 基线取得最高 17.9× 端到端加速。其发布版本使用手工调优的 Triton 算子。作者让 Evolving Agent Teams 以 Triton 源码（而非朴素 PyTorch 基线）为参考，把 assignment 算子改写为 CUDA，最终得到的 CUDA WGMMA 算子在默认负载上相对 Triton 达到 1.71× 加速，并在整个基准网格上于计算受限配置（大 K）最多降低 1.5× 延迟。

4.5 Ablation Studies消融实验

Figure 6 compares Evolving Agent Teams against two ablation baselines on MLA decode. The fixed four-role team (Profiler, Hardware Researcher, Planner, Implementer) reaches 0.31×: role specialization helps early on, but the static configuration cannot adapt when the optimization landscape shifts, e.g., it lacks a Knowledge Integrator to prevent cross-agents information asymmetry or a Challenger to break premature ceiling declarations (examples in Appendix B). Codex (GPT-5.5 xhigh, 258K context) reaches 0.28×, confirming that the gains of Evolving Agent Teams (0.74×) are not solely due to model choice. The 0.31× → 0.74× gap between the fixed team and the evolving team isolates the value of team evolution: both use the same model and multi-agent structure, but only the evolving system can restructure roles and coordination in response to diagnosed failure modes.

图 6 在 MLA decode 上把 Evolving Agent Teams 与两个消融基线对比。固定四角色团队（剖析者、硬件研究者、规划者、实现者）仅达到 0.31×：角色专业化在早期有帮助，但静态配置在优化格局变化时无法适应——例如它缺少一个防止智能体间信息不对称的知识整合者，也缺少一个打破过早「性能天花板」宣告的挑战者（示例见附录 B）。Codex（GPT-5.5 xhigh，258K 上下文）达到 0.28×，这证实 Evolving Agent Teams 的收益（0.74×）并非单纯来自模型选择。固定团队与演化团队之间 0.31× → 0.74× 的差距，恰好隔离出「团队演化」本身的价值：两者使用相同的模型与多智能体结构，但只有演化系统能针对已诊断的失败模式重构角色与协作。

Figure 7. Full runs on four further settings: harness evaluation at the end of each iteration vs. API cost. (a) MI350X, from a port of vLLM's kernels. Finally, we ask whether full runs can surpass the best existing systems on new hardware and in new domains, with the same supervisor prompt, no predefined roles, and newer models (Opus/Sonnet 5.5; single runs). On Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) prefill, the team's kernel is 3.01× faster than vLLM's hand-written production HIP kernels on AMD MI350X, and 3.44× faster than FlashKDA, a fused CUTLASS implementation, on B200. It makes a Metal port of FreeToken, which runs Qwen3.8-Flash-Next in MLX 4-bit on a 48 GB Apple M4 Pro by streaming experts from SSD, serve recorded coding-agent sessions 3.32× faster. On RoboDojo it writes a code policy for 42 simulated dual-arm manipulation tasks that scores 62.1 on held-out seeds, above the best leaderboard entry (55.3 as of Oct. 26, 2026) and the π0.5 VLA alone (11.4). 05

Conclusion结论与局限

Strong coding agents make rapid initial progress on GPU kernel optimization but converge to local optima well below expert-written baselines. Evolving Agent Teams escapes these local optima by evolving the team's organization alongside the search: a central supervisor diagnoses each plateau and restructures the team's roles, grounded in a persistent file system. Across four CUDA kernel optimization tasks on Hopper and Blackwell GPUs, it consistently outperforms strong coding-agent baselines under a matched token budget, and with additional budget it surpasses the production FlashInfer MLA decode kernel at 1.21× mean speedup across 47 workloads. It also demonstrates superior performance on tasks such as KDA prefill on AMD and NVIDIA GPUs, MoE expert-offload serving on Apple silicon, and robot manipulation.

Limitations. We run each main setting twice and each setting in Section 4.7 once, which limits statistical comparisons; a cost-vs-performance Pareto analysis and a controlled study of noisier domains remain future work.

强编程智能体在 GPU 算子优化上初期进展很快，却会收敛到远低于专家基线的局部最优。Evolving Agent Teams 通过让团队组织与搜索同步演化来摆脱这些局部最优：由一位中央监督者诊断每一次停滞，并在持久化文件系统的支撑下重构团队角色。在 Hopper 与 Blackwell GPU 上的四个 CUDA 算子优化任务中，它在匹配 token 预算下持续优于强编程智能体基线；在追加预算后，它在 47 个负载上以 1.21× 平均加速超越生产版 FlashInfer MLA decode 算子。它还在 AMD 与 NVIDIA GPU 上的 KDA prefill、Apple 芯片上的 MoE 专家卸载服务，以及机器人操作等任务上展现出更优性能。

局限。每个主要设置只跑两次，4.7 节的每个设置只跑一次，这限制了统计比较的可靠性；成本与性能的帕累托分析，以及在噪声更大领域中的受控研究，仍属未来工作。

B. Why the Fixed Four-Role Baseline Starts Slowly固定四角色基线为何起步缓慢

Figure 6 shows the fixed four-role baseline (Planner, Hardware Researcher, Implementer, and Profiler; all Claude Opus 4.7, coordinating through a shared filesystem and a SendMessage primitive) reaching its first correctness-passing commit substantially later than the single agent on MLA decode. Most of this delay is traceable to a single class of bug: a low-level SMEM-layout mismatch in which WGMMA on SM90 requires 8×8 atom-tiled shared memory, but the Implementer wrote row-major tiles, silently corrupting the QK output.

The information needed to identify the bug is present in the team but partitioned across agents: the Hardware Researcher holds the layout requirement, the Implementer holds the actual SMEM declaration, and both agree on the descriptor numerics, leading them to localize the bug elsewhere. The team iterates through incorrect hypotheses without any agent reading the Implementer's source to inspect the layout, despite all having Read access. A single agent holding both specification and code in its context would identify the discrepancy on direct inspection.

The failure is structural rather than capability-driven. Each role's charter implicitly scopes its outputs (the Hardware Researcher operates as a recipe expert, not an auditor); spawn prompts specify reactive behavior, locking roles into question-and-answer loops that preclude proactive code inspection; and the SendMessage primitive carries prose, encouraging abstract agreement ("LBO=16, confirm?") over byte-level cross-checking. Fixed-role multi-agent systems can therefore stall on debugging tasks that cross role boundaries. Evolving Agent Teams addresses this class of failure: the supervisor diagnoses the stall as a knowledge gap and introduces a Knowledge Integrator that mandates cross-agent artifact reads.

图 6 显示，在 MLA decode 上，固定四角色基线（规划者、硬件研究者、实现者、剖析者；均为 Claude Opus 4.7，通过共享文件系统与 SendMessage 原语协作）首次通过正确性检查的提交，比单智能体晚得多。这一延迟大部分可归因于同一类 bug：SMEM 布局不匹配——SM90 上的 WGMMA 要求 8×8 的 atom-tiled 共享内存，而实现者写成了行主序 tile，静默地破坏了 QK 输出。

识别该 bug 所需的信息在团队中存在，却被分割在不同智能体手里：硬件研究者掌握布局要求，实现者掌握实际的 SMEM 声明，而两人对描述符的数值看法一致，于是把 bug 定位到了别处。团队不断在错误假设之间循环，却没有任何智能体去读实现者的源码检查布局——尽管所有人都拥有读权限。若由一个同时把规格与代码放在上下文中的智能体来看，直接检查便能发现这一不一致。

这是结构性的失败，而非能力不足。每个角色的章程都隐式限定了其产出范围（硬件研究者扮演的是「配方专家」而非「审计者」）；派生提示词规定了反应式行为，把角色锁定在问答循环里，无法主动检查代码；SendMessage 原语传递的是自然语言散文，鼓励「LBO=16，确认？」这类抽象共识，而非字节级的交叉核对。因此，固定角色的多智能体系统会在跨越角色边界的调试任务上卡住。Evolving Agent Teams 正是针对这一类失败：监督者把停滞诊断为知识缺口，并引入知识整合者，强制跨智能体读取彼此产物。

C. Details of the Additional Settings额外设置的细节

All four runs use the same supervisor prompt and harness as the main experiments, with no predefined roles. Each is a single run, so we report them as case studies rather than controlled comparisons; the matched-budget solo ablations are in Appendix D. Costs are booked agent and supervisor API spend at published per-token prices.

四次运行均使用与主实验相同的监督者提示词与 harness，且不预定义任何角色。由于每次只有一次运行，作者将其作为案例研究而非受控对比来报告；匹配预算下的单智能体消融见附录 D。成本按公开的每 token 价格计为智能体与监督者的 API 支出。

KDA prefill on AMD MI350X · AMD MI350X 上的 KDA prefill

Kimi Delta Attention is a gated delta rule with a per-key-channel forget gate and a matrix-valued fp32 state; the kernel computes the chunked prefill from the raw projections (normalization, gates and recurrence). The task uses one MI350X (CDNA4) and the tensor-parallel shape of a production deployment (4 heads per GPU, TP=8). The baseline is vLLM's hand-written fused HIP prefill kernels used in production; the starting kernel is a port of them (score 0.98×). The score is the arithmetic mean of baseline-over-candidate latency across 10 variable-length workloads (single sequences of 1K–64K tokens, batches from 8K to 128K, and one mixed batch), with the cache flushed before each timed run. Correctness requires relative L2 error ≤ 0.02 on outputs and final states; the team itself found that the evaluation's fast-decaying gates let state-handoff bugs pass, and added a slow-decay check that every subsequent kernel had to pass, along with a held-out shape set that is checked but not scored. The run used Claude Opus 5.5 (medium effort) for all agents, lasted 73 iterations (186 hours), and booked $3.0K. The final kernel scores 3.01× (mean of five re-measurements; per-workload 2.4×–3.5×) and is 1.15× faster than the Triton kernel from Flash Linear Attention. Its main structural changes are a "relay" that fuses the prologue with the recurrence and passes the state between workgroups through the shared L2 cache, bf16/fp16 state handoffs and non-temporal loads, fp16 matrix operands (1.2× and more accurate than bf16), and a "twin route" that feeds one 64-token recurrence step from two 32-token prologues.

Kimi Delta Attention 是一种带「逐键通道遗忘门」与矩阵值 fp32 状态的 gated delta rule；该算子从原始投影计算分块 prefill（归一化、门控与递推）。任务使用一台 MI350X（CDNA4），并采用生产部署的张量并行形状（每 GPU 4 个头，TP=8）。基线是 vLLM 生产环境手写的融合 HIP prefill 算子，起点算子为其移植版（得分 0.98×）。得分是 10 个变长负载上「基线延迟/候选延迟」的算术平均（单序列 1K–64K token、批量 8K–128K，以及一个混合批），每次计时前都清空缓存。正确性要求输出与最终状态的相对 L2 误差 ≤ 0.02；团队自己发现该评测中「快速衰减」的门控会让状态交接 bug 蒙混过关，于是增加了一项慢衰减检查（后续每个算子都必须通过），以及一套只检查不计分的留出形状。该次运行中所有智能体使用 Claude Opus 5.5（中等思考强度），历时 73 次迭代（186 小时），计费 3,000 美元。最终算子得分 3.01×（五次重测的平均；逐负载 2.4×–3.5×），并比 Flash Linear Attention 的 Triton 算子快 1.15×。其主要结构性改动包括：把前导段与递推融合、并通过共享 L2 缓存在各工作组之间传递状态的「接力（relay）」；bf16/fp16 状态交接与非临时加载；fp16 矩阵操作数（相比 bf16 有 1.2× 提升且更精确）；以及用两个 32-token 前导供给一个 64-token 递推步骤的「双路径（twin route）」。

KDA prefill on B200 · B200 上的 KDA prefill

The task is the same operator on B200 (sm_100a), scored as the geomean speedup over FlashKDA, a fused CUTLASS implementation, in a clean room with no web access. The team could read FlashKDA, the Triton KDA kernels of Flash Linear Attention, the CUTLASS/CuTe examples, FlashAttention-4, and a read-only snapshot of FlashInfer at commit a9e03bf2 (Aug. 13, 2026), which includes the SM100 KDA prefill kernels that CAKE contributed to FlashInfer; the team ported these in the first iteration (1.96×). The score covers six workloads (8,192 tokens, 8K–64K, fixed and variable-length layouts). Iterations 1–5 used Claude Opus 5.5 and later iterations Claude Sonnet 5.5. Comparison with KDA2: KDA2 reports 3.02× over FlashKDA on B300 on the same six workloads. We recompiled the team's final kernel for B300 (sm_103a, no code change) and scored it and KDA2's released kernels with the same harness on the same B300: 3.54× for ours, against 3.02× (TIRx), 2.85× (PTX), and 2.79× (CuTe-DSL) for KDA2. On B200, the same harness gives 3.44×, against 2.79× (TIRx) and 2.44× (CuTe-DSL); the PTX kernels run only on B300. Because the run starts from a port of an existing kernel, it measures improvement over a strong start rather than from scratch.

同一算子在 B200（sm_100a）上的任务，以其相对 FlashKDA（融合 CUTLASS 实现）的几何平均加速为得分，并在无网络访问的净室环境中运行。团队可以阅读 FlashKDA、Flash Linear Attention 的 Triton KDA 算子、CUTLASS/CuTe 示例、FlashAttention-4，以及 FlashInfer 在提交 a9e03bf2（2026 年 8 月 13 日）的只读快照——其中包含 CAKE 贡献给 FlashInfer 的 SM100 KDA prefill 算子；团队在第一次迭代就移植了它们（1.96×）。得分覆盖六个负载（8,192 token、8K–64K、定长与变长布局）。迭代 1–5 使用 Claude Opus 5.5，之后使用 Claude Sonnet 5.5。与 KDA2 的对比：KDA2 报告在同一六个负载上、B300 上相对 FlashKDA 为 3.02×。作者把团队的最终算子为 B300（sm_103a）重新编译（未改代码），并在同一台 B300 上用同一 harness 评测它与 KDA2 发布的算子：本文为 3.54×，KDA2 分别为 3.02×（TIRx）、2.85×（PTX）、2.79×（CuTe-DSL）。在 B200 上，同一 harness 给出 3.44×，而 KDA2 为 2.79×（TIRx）与 2.44×（CuTe-DSL）；PTX 算子只能在 B300 上运行。由于该次运行从既有算子的移植版出发，它衡量的是在强起点上的改进，而非从零开始。

MoE expert-offload serving on Apple silicon · Apple 芯片上的 MoE 专家卸载服务

The task is to make a Metal port of the FreeToken MoE serving system serve Qwen3.8-Flash-Next at 4 bits (about 79 GB of weights plus a 32 GB per-layer embedding table; 512 routed experts per layer, top-10 plus a shared expert) as fast as possible on a 48 GB M4 Pro Mac, streaming experts that do not fit in memory from SSD through an offload cache. The model and math must stay the same: no expert skipping or pruning, no lower top-k, no fewer bits. Gates check top-1 agreement with the naive engine's greedy predictions, KL divergence, peak memory (≤ 48 GiB), swap growth, and load time, and a candidate that fails any gate scores 0. The score is the mean over workload terms of baseline time over candidate time; the workload replays sessions recorded from a real coding-agent loop, teacher-forced from a cold page cache, plus a batch-1 decode benchmark. All agents used Claude Opus 5.5, with web search and fetch tools disabled. The supervisor resized the team from one agent to three and finally to two, and re-cut its roles six times: by file type (I/O vs. compute), by bottleneck (speculation, cache, offload), by time slice (decode vs. prefill), and by measured gap (GPU time per token). Main changes include a victim cache for evicted experts, compact GPU expert slots with shared palette indices, (scale, bias) palette compression that cuts expert reads by 7%, and admission rather than eviction as the residency lever, after a cache role found that most decode misses had already been read during the preceding prefill. The final engine decodes at 30.3 tokens/s on the batch-1 decode benchmark, against 9.1 for the naive engine.

任务是把 FreeToken MoE 服务系统移植为 Metal 版本，使 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 在 4 bit 下（约 79 GB 权重，外加 32 GB 的逐层嵌入表；每层 512 个路由专家，top-10 加一个共享专家）在一台 48 GB 的 M4 Pro Mac 上尽可能快地服务——把放不进内存的专家通过卸载缓存从 SSD 流式加载。模型与计算必须保持不变：不做专家跳过或剪枝、不降低 top-k、不降低位宽。准入检查（gates）会核验与朴素引擎贪心预测的 top-1 一致率、KL 散度、峰值内存（≤ 48 GiB）、swap 增长与加载时间，任一项不通过则该候选记 0 分。得分是各负载项上「基线时间/候选时间」的均值；负载会回放从真实编程智能体循环录制的会话（在冷页缓存下 teacher-forced），外加一个 batch-1 解码基准。所有智能体使用 Claude Opus 5.5，并禁用网络检索与抓取工具。监督者把团队从 1 个智能体扩到 3 个、最终收敛到 2 个，并六次重划角色边界：按文件类型（I/O vs. 计算）、按瓶颈（投机、缓存、卸载）、按时间片（解码 vs. prefill）、按实测缺口（每 token 的 GPU 时间）。主要改动包括：为被逐出的专家设 victim cache；用共享调色板索引压缩 GPU 专家槽位；用 (scale, bias) 调色板压缩把专家读取减少 7%；以及在某个缓存角色发现「多数解码未命中其实已在前面的 prefill 阶段被读过」之后，把常驻策略从「逐出」改为「准入」。最终引擎在 batch-1 解码基准上达到 30.3 tokens/s，而朴素引擎为 9.1。

RoboDojo · RoboDojo 机器人操作

RoboDojo has 42 dual-arm manipulation tasks in Isaac Sim, grouped into five dimensions (generalization, memory, precision, long-horizon, open-ended); the leaderboard score is the mean of the five dimension means of per-task partial-credit scores (0–100). The team edits a Python controller package with per-task skill modules. At run time the policy may call the frozen π0.5 checkpoint and a runtime LLM (Claude, at most 20 calls per episode); inputs are three RGB cameras, joint states, and the instruction, and no model training is allowed. The agents' outbound network is limited to the Anthropic API and the evaluation fleet, and other leaderboard entries' policy code is removed from the hosts. Agents develop on seed 1; seeds 0 and 2 are held out and evaluated only by the operator, and agents never see those scores. Iterations 1–36 optimize a 10-task subset; iterations 37–51 use all 42 tasks. The supervisor and all agents used Claude Sonnet 5.5, and the run booked $472 through iteration 50 (excluding runtime-LLM calls). The iteration-50 policy scores 62.1 held-out (50 episodes per task on each held-out seed) and 64.4 on dev.

RoboDojo 在 Isaac Sim 中有 42 个双臂操作任务，分为五个维度（泛化、记忆、精度、长程、开放式）；排行榜分数为五个维度均值的平均，各维度取自各任务的部分得分（0–100）。团队编辑一个 Python 控制器包，内含逐任务的技能模块。运行期策略可以调用冻结的 π0.5 检查点，以及一个运行时 LLM（Claude，每回合最多 20 次调用）；输入为三个 RGB 相机、关节状态与指令，不允许训练模型。智能体的外网访问仅限 Anthropic API 与评测集群，主机上其他排行榜条目的策略代码已被移除。智能体在种子 1 上开发；种子 0 与 2 为留出集，仅由操作员评测，智能体始终看不到这些分数。迭代 1–36 优化一个 10 任务子集，迭代 37–51 使用全部 42 个任务。监督者与所有智能体使用 Claude Sonnet 5.5，截至第 50 次迭代计费 472 美元（不含运行时 LLM 调用）。第 50 次迭代的策略在留出集上得分 62.1（每个留出种子上每任务 50 回合），在开发集上为 64.4。

D. Matched-Budget Solo Ablations匹配预算下的单智能体消融

On two of the additional settings we compare the team against a single Claude Code agent with the same model at matched spend. On MI350X, from the same starting commit and task statement, at $300 the solo agent (Opus 5.5, medium effort) reaches 1.93×, while the team reaches 2.36×. On the offload task, starting from the team's 1.9× engine, the two are close at $200 (1.11× for solo vs. 1.13×, averaged over the dev and two held-out workloads), but within the same 20-hour window the solo agent progresses more slowly and spends only $200, while the team reaches 1.26× at $509.

A second run starts both the team and a solo agent from the final engine of the run in Appendix C (about 3.3× naive), each on two identical Macs, both shown a $1,000 budget, and both stopped at the same 20-hour deadline. Table 4 reports all versions re-measured afterwards in the same batch on the same machines, on the dev workload and on two held-out workloads: (A) a long prefix-reuse session and (B) four real Claude Code sessions. At $200 the team and the solo agent are close; the solo agent leads on the workload it optimized and the team on both held-out workloads. The solo agent's later changes are mostly small parameter tweaks (e.g., the half-life of the expert-cache eviction policy), which help the dev workload more than the held-out ones. The solo agent progressed more slowly and spent $200 in the 20 hours, while the team kept improving through $509 (decode lookahead hints, then exact multi-row verification enabling speculative decoding, then a larger victim cache), and its final engine is the fastest on every workload. Measured together on the same Macs, it decodes at 35.2 tokens/s on the batch-1 decode benchmark, against 19.6 for the starting commit and 29.4 for the solo agent's final engine.

在其中两个附加设置上，作者以相同模型、匹配花费把团队与单个 Claude Code 智能体对比。在 MI350X 上，从相同的起点提交与任务说明出发，花到 300 美元时单智能体（Opus 5.5，中等思考强度）达到 1.93×，而团队达到 2.36×。在卸载任务上，从团队的 1.9× 引擎出发，两者在 200 美元时很接近（单智能体 1.11×，团队 1.13×，开发集与两个留出负载的平均），但在同一个 20 小时窗口内单智能体推进更慢、只花了 200 美元，而团队花到 509 美元时达到 1.26×。

第二次运行让团队与单智能体都从附录 C 那次运行的最终引擎（约 3.3× 朴素）出发，各用两台相同的 Mac，都给出 1,000 美元预算，并在同一个 20 小时截止点停止。表 4 报告了事后在同一批、同一机器上重测的所有版本，覆盖开发负载与两个留出负载：(A) 一个长前缀复用会话，(B) 四个真实的 Claude Code 会话。200 美元时两者接近：单智能体在它自己优化的负载上领先，团队在两个留出负载上领先。单智能体后来的改动多是小的参数调整（例如专家缓存逐出策略的半衰期），对开发负载的帮助大于对留出负载的帮助。单智能体推进更慢，20 小时内只花掉 200 美元；而团队一路改进到 509 美元（先后是解码前瞻提示、使投机解码可行的精确多行验证，以及更大的 victim cache），其最终引擎在每一个负载上都最快。在同一批 Mac 上一起测量，它在 batch-1 解码基准上达到 35.2 tokens/s，而起点提交为 19.6、单智能体最终引擎为 29.4。

Key Insights观点提取（笔者归纳，非原文）

Below are the paper's central claims, restated as transferable insights. Each is grounded in a specific piece of evidence in the paper; the English headline is a paraphrase, not a quotation.

以下把论文的核心主张重述为可迁移的洞见。每一条都对应论文中的具体证据；英文小标题为笔者概括，不是原文引用。

Organizational mismatch, not capability

局部最优的根因是「组织与阶段错配」，而不是模型能力不足

论文最有说服力的一点，是把失败归因从「模型不够强」转向「团队结构与当前工作阶段不匹配」。Codex 5.5（28%）、固定四角色团队（55%）、Claude Code（51%）三种不同强度的系统都停在 MLA decode 同一量级，而唯一变化的变量是「是否允许重组团队」。这构成一个干净的对照：瓶颈不在单步推理，而在长时间任务的组织形态。

T = (R, Π, M) as a first-class optimization variable

把「团队配置」显式参数化，是本文最可复用的方法论贡献

用角色集合 R、协作协议 Π、知识管理 M 三轴刻画任意多智能体系统，使「演化」有了明确的动作空间，而不是含糊的「让智能体更聪明」。任何想复用该框架的人，都可以直接用这三轴审计自己系统的静态假设在哪里。

Diagnosis before restructuring

监督者的输入是「行为轨迹的诊断」，不是「分数曲线」

监督者不是简单的早停/加预算控制器。它读的是行为模式：滑向容易路径、跨团队洞见丢失、卡在调试、过度微优化。V1→V2 的案例尤其典型——它诊断出的问题是「缺乏纪律」，于是造出一个纪律官，而不是给更多预算或换更强模型。这种「把症状翻译成结构改动」的能力，是当前多数自动优化框架缺失的一层。

Knowledge decay is the dominant failure mode

长期任务中最大的结构性弱点是「知识衰减」，而非算力不足

V7→V8 的案例显示：V4 已经给出关键建议（「用 WGMMA RS，把 P 放在寄存器」），但 V5–V7 全部忽略，因为该建议写在 V4 的报告里而没有进入共享学习文档。团队的失败不是因为不知道，而是因为知道的东西没有进入可复用的公共记忆。对策是引入 SYNTHESIS.md 并强制阅读——一个极低成本、极高杠杆的改动（0.50→0.51 之后直接解锁 V9 的集成）。

Discipline must be externalized

硬约束不能交给智能体「自觉遵守」，必须外化为角色或门禁

「必须用 WGMMA」「一次提交只改一处」「先剖析再改」这类约束，在压力下会被智能体放弃，并出现钻规则空子的行为（论文提到一次被监督者拦截）。把纪律做成一个专职角色，比写在提示词里更可靠。这对任何长跑型 agent pipeline 都是直接可用的工程建议。

Parallelism is orchestration, not a permission

并行是监督者的编排职责，而不是授予子智能体的权限

V5 的实验很说明问题：把「可以派生伙伴」的权限交给工作智能体，它从未使用；由监督者直接拆成两个隔离分支的专职角色后，才拿到 +44%。这说明在长任务中，智能体缺乏对自身组织方式的元认知，编排必须上移一层。

Structural change invalidates profiling

架构级改动会让既有剖析结论整体失效，必须重新建立瓶颈模型

V9 把两个 GEMM 都切到 WGMMA 后，此前的瓶颈分析全部过时；重新剖析后 9 次提交即取得 +32%，而单靠 Split-K 重调只有 +4.1。这条经验对性能工程是常识，但把它作为团队设计决策（换掉优化者的角色与纪律）写进框架，是本文的新意。

The implementation family sets the ceiling

决定性能上限的是「实现族」选择，而非在既定族内的调参

表 2 提供了干净的证据：同等预算下，EAT 两次都落在 WGMMA 族（0.72×/0.69×），K-Search 两次都落在 WMMA 族（0.60×），CUDAForge 两次都落在标量/SIMT 族（0.45×/0.28×）。差距不是调参精度，而是所在族的上限。这条结论可直接迁移到任何「易写但受限」与「难写但高上限」并存的搜索问题。

Same prompt, new domains

「监督者 + 文件系统」这一层具有跨域可迁移性

4.7 节用同一份监督者提示词、不预定义角色，直接跑到 AMD HIP 算子、Apple Metal MoE 服务、甚至 Isaac Sim 机器人操作策略。这是本文外部效度最强的证据：可迁移的不是领域知识，而是「诊断—重组—累积」这套元流程。不过这些都是一次运行，强度有限。

Cost is part of the result

必须把成本写进结论，否则「更强」无法被采用

论文始终坚持按 token 计价报告成本（$800 匹配预算、$1K、$3K/186 小时等），并给出「同等花费下的对比」。这在 agent 研究中并不常见，却是把结果转化为工程决策的必要条件。反过来，最贵的单次运行（AMD，$3K、186 小时）也提示：收益并非线性可达。

07

Critical Evaluation论文评价（笔者观点）

Overall. This is a strong systems paper: a well-chosen hard benchmark, a clean abstraction, an unusually complete evidence chain (four budget-controlled tasks, seven additional settings, two ablations, and detailed evolution case studies), and honest reporting of dead ends. Its main weakness is statistical: most comparisons are best-of-two or single runs, and the model generations differ across baselines.

总体判断。这是一篇扎实的系统类论文：基准选得硬、抽象干净、证据链异常完整（四个预算受控任务 + 七个附加设置 + 两组消融 + 详细的演化案例），并且如实报告了死胡同。主要弱点在统计层面：多数对比是「两次取优」或单次运行，且不同基线的模型代际不一致。

优点 · Strengths

  • 选题把「开放式发现」而非「修 bug」作为 agent 的考场。GPU 算子优化有客观、可复现、专家基线极强的特点，是检验长跑 agent 的理想压力测试。
  • 抽象T=(R,Π,M) 三轴把杂乱的多智能体设计压缩成可操作的变量，使「演化」可被讨论、可被审计。
  • 证据消融设计有针对性：固定四角色团队（同模型、同多智能体结构、只去掉监督者）把「团队演化」的价值从「多智能体」和「模型能力」中隔离出来（0.31→0.74）。
  • 诚实报告失败：专职调试者确认 P@V 是死胡同、GDN 有 37/100 负载仍低于基线、最差负载仅 0.19×。这类负面结果显著提升了可信度。
  • 资料案例研究颗粒度高（V1→V10 的行为/反思/设计/结果四段式），使读者能复现「监督者如何思考」，而不只是看到一个分数。
  • 工程成本透明：按 token 计价、给出匹配预算对比，并开源代码。

局限 · Weaknesses

  • 统计样本量不足：主实验 n=2 且取优（best-of-two），4.7 节全为单次运行，无置信区间、无显著性检验。取优会系统性高估。
  • 基线模型代际混淆：主实验用 Opus 4.6，固定团队用 Opus 4.7 1M，4.7 节用 Opus/Sonnet 5.5，Codex 用 GPT-5.5。跨节比较时，「方法增益」与「模型增益」难以完全分离。
  • 口径指标口径需要小心解读：MLA 分数相对 run() 且排除 plan()（与生产基线 0.77× 换算）；GDN 的高加速很大程度来自「无需 planning 阶段」在大量小 shape 上的优势。几何平均可能被小负载主导，不能直接读作通用算子效率提升。
  • 归因「团队演化」与「更多并行智能体 / 更多 token」未完全分离。EAT 天然会派生更多智能体，匹配 token 预算是否也匹配了并行度与墙钟时间，文中未给出完整核算。
  • 监督者监督者本身是黑箱 LLM：诊断质量、错误率、成本占比均未量化；只报告了一次拦截「钻规则空子」的轶事。若监督者误诊，系统可能持续在错误方向上重组。
  • 复现依赖闭源商用模型：开源的是框架代码，但 Claude/GPT 的行为、价格与可用性都不可控，严格复现几乎不可能；「两次取优」也进一步削弱可复现性。
  • 对比缺少与 AlphaEvolve / FunSearch 类方法的直接同台对比，仅在 MLA 上与 K-Search、CUDAForge 对比；也未与「同等算力下多跑几个独立单智能体再取优」这一朴素基线对比。
  • 一致性同一基线在文中出现两个数字：引言称固定四角色团队达到专家性能的 55%，而 4.5 节消融中同一基线为 0.31×。两者可能对应不同预算/评测设置，但正文未说明差异来源，读者容易误读。
  • 泛化作者自认局限：未做成本–性能帕累托分析，也未在「噪声更大」（评分不稳定、反馈稀疏）的领域做受控研究。RoboDojo 等结果是一次运行的案例，不是受控结论。

Credibility. Internal validity is high for the central claim (same model, same multi-agent scaffold, only restructuring differs → 0.31× vs 0.74×), and the cross-domain runs argue for external validity. But the strength of specific numbers should be discounted: best-of-two reporting, one-run generalization claims, and heterogeneous model generations mean the headline figures (1.21×, 3.44×, 62.1) are existence proofs rather than stable estimates. The qualitative mechanism (diagnosis → restructuring → persistent knowledge) is the robust part.

Who should read it. Agent-framework builders (the T=(R,Π,M) framing and the knowledge-decay diagnosis are directly reusable), performance engineers interested in agent-written kernels, and evaluation researchers (as a case study in how hard it is to attribute gains in multi-agent systems).

可信度。对核心主张而言，内部效度较高（同模型、同多智能体骨架，唯一差别是能否重组 → 0.31× vs 0.74×），跨域运行也为外部效度提供了论据。但具体数字应打折看待：两次取优的报告方式、单次运行的泛化结论、以及混杂的模型代际，意味着「1.21×、3.44×、62.1」这些头条数字更像存在性证明，而非稳定估计。真正稳健的是定性机制：诊断 → 重组 → 持久知识。

适合谁读。智能体框架开发者（T=(R,Π,M) 的刻画与「知识衰减」诊断可直接复用）、关注「智能体写算子」的性能工程师，以及评测研究者（可作为「多智能体系统增益难以归因」的典型案例）。

8.3/10

结论：强烈推荐阅读，但请只信「机制」，对「数字」保持折扣。

它给出了一个可操作的范式（把团队组织当作优化变量，用诊断驱动重组，用持久文件系统对抗知识衰减），并用一个极硬的基准证明了该范式的存在性。它还没有证明该范式的稳定性、成本效率与统计可靠性——这恰好是后续工作最有价值的空间：多随机种子与置信区间、监督者质量与成本的量化、与「多开几个独立 agent 取优」的公平对比，以及在噪声更大领域中的受控验证。

“The bottleneck is not the strength of a single agent, but the fit between the organization and the stage of discovery.” —— 本文核心思想的凝练（笔者概括，非原文）
